dict.Fișierul .eps conține doar desen PostScr: The .eps file contains only PostScript drawing and its thumbnail is damaged. Save it as PDF or SVG from the program it was made in and open that instead.
dict.Fișierul .eps e deteriorat și nu poate f: The .eps file is damaged and cannot be read.
dict.Fișierul .eps conține doar desen PostScr: The .eps file contains only PostScript drawing, with no picture inside, and it cannot be drawn here. Save it as PDF or SVG from the program it was made in and open that instead.

templates.Desenul PostScript din fișierul .eps nu: The PostScript drawing in the .eps file cannot be drawn here, so its preview picture was opened instead ({0}), smaller and sometimes black and white only. For full quality, save it as PDF or SVG from the program it was made in.
templates.Fișierul .eps a fost deschis cu pixelii: The .eps file was opened with the pixels stored in it ({0}); saving produces PNG, JPG, TIFF or another common format.
